lesson_title: Two Ways Are Better Than One
hook_text: R248 635 plus R99 999. Can you do it in your head in three seconds?
clip_script: A car dealer in Gqeberha adds R248 635 and R99 999. Columns? Carry, carry, carry. Or be clever. R99 999 is nearly R100 000. Add R100 000: R348 635. You added R1 too much, so take it back: R348 634. Done! Now take away R19 998 from R76 412. Take away R20 000: R56 412. You took R2 too many, so give R2 back: R56 414. Then check! Adding? Subtract to undo it. Estimate to see if it makes sense. One way to work it out, another to check.
visual_style: Number line jumps landing on round numbers, with a little arrow stepping back or forward to compensate, and a calculator stamping a check mark.
mood: Clever and playful, like a magic trick explained.
pacing: Quick mental sum, slow-motion compensating step, then a snappy check.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and count on to find R50 000 take away R37 850.
